However, there are a few excellent options depending on what your business does.

Great for small businesses, consultants, service providers and startups.

- Easy drag-and-drop email builder
- Automated welcome emails and follow-ups
- Landing pages and signup forms
- Affordable as your business grows

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$10–12/month.

Free plan available; paid plans from around \$9/month.

[Visit Brevo](https://www.brevo.com/)

Great for beginners who want a familiar platform with lots of integrations.

- Professional email templates

- Lots of third-party integrations

[Visit Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/)

![ActiveCampaign - Blue Ninja](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EouKh9P45dha8lf5y8rFcjosqmGPnqMhUC4vUxsIsmJOZKXfFv0WZ2M1Rt5aQTQVatptyFzb00u5rqUyyUt5nfAXNZcW3dYEUdrs0bSWR3k4b7jAtS4qbGi6ODF8iEsLzx8-yCF6Ei8Iq2gQO7peSlhUyHgt-4tOb8_yPRbh44WijrMMqO0EHfxwcZeCPQ-d?purpose=fullsize)
